setup: CREATE TABLE c2_string_agg AS SELECT i, i%8192 AS many_group, i%64 AS few_group, CASE WHEN i%17=16 THEN NULL WHEN i%7=0 THEN 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' ELSE 'v' || (i%31)::VARCHAR END AS value, i%97 AS order_key FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: string_agg_few_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(length(aggregate_value)) FROM (SELECT string_agg(value, '|') AS aggregate_value FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY few_group)

workloads.name: string_agg_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(length(aggregate_value)) FROM (SELECT string_agg(value, '|') AS aggregate_value FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY many_group)

workloads.name: string_agg_ordered_distinct
workloads.sql: SELECT length(string_agg(DISTINCT value, '|' ORDER BY value)) FROM c2_string_agg

workloads.name: string_agg_sum_list_consumers
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(sum_value) + sum(length(first_value)) + sum(length(aggregate_value)) FROM (SELECT sum(i) AS sum_value, list_extract(list(value ORDER BY order_key), 1) AS first_value, string_agg(value, '|') AS aggregate_value FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY few_group)
